notes.title: Heroes of the Seven Island
notes.content:
I'm glad to announce the forthcoming release of my second game, after “The Secret of Darkwoods”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43466237/09a53c69c1fccae0a2b9feb1aee49e800a394527.png[/img]

Heroes of the Seven Islands is a comfy yet challenging non-linear heroic adventure with side quests in a vast light fairy tale world, inspired by 90s games.


[h1]Click here to wishlist[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010290/Heroes_of_the_Seven_Islands


[list]
[*] Hundreds of hand-drawn unique illustrations
[*] Turn based yet fast combat system
[*] Play the main quest or explore the open world and start side quests
[*] Discover villages, cities, dungeons, swamps, caves, forests, cemeteries and temples
[*] Music by Dungeon Synth Artists
[/list]

[previewyoutube=AOp28rRlfvg;full][/previewyoutube]
